title: Resolution urging Congress to restore Haiti's Temporary Protected Status
summary: This resolution calls on the U.S. Senate to pass, and the President to sign, S.4814, which would require the Secretary of Homeland Security to designate Haiti for Temporary Protected Status until three months after January 20, 2029. It responds to the June 2026 Supreme Court ruling in Mullin v. Doe allowing termination of TPS for Haitian nationals, who number an estimated 40,000 in New York City. The Council states this would protect Haitian New Yorkers from deportation and preserve their work authorization.
